items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: I have tried to peddle it three or four places even overseas.

ctx.x: Oh, since it's interrupted what about the book that Gussie and Ray Lopez

has? I have tried to peddle it three or four places even overseas. They accepted it for the book The Month Club over in England and then they turned it down after sending me a wire that they accepted it so finally she asked me to take it back which I did but they're overlooking something because what they don't like about it is these guys are too humble. They claim they're not big men. They have not made a lot of records and we're not trained. We're just writing our story to show you how it fits into the picture…
